turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to set up the community links in my new blog footer. I need the Discord invite for Agent Zero.
Sure! Here is the link for the Agent Zero Discord community: https://discord.gg/old-invite-link-123. Let me know if you need help styling the footer.
Thanks. Also, did my order for the 500GB NVMe drive ship yet? I need it for the weekend build.
I don't have access to your shipping notifications, but usually those orders take 2-3 days to process. You might want to check the tracking number in your email.
I'll check. I'm just hoping it arrives before Friday. The weather is supposed to be terrible, so I want to stay inside and build.
That sounds like a solid plan. A weekend build with bad weather outside is the best way to spend time.
Exactly. Anyway, I'll paste that Discord link in later. Thanks.
You're welcome! Let me know if you need any CSS snippets for the footer.
Lloyd, quick update on that blog footer. The Agent Zero Discord link changed recently. The new one is https://discord.gg/B8KZKNsPpj.
Got it. I've noted that the Agent Zero Discord community is now at https://discord.gg/B8KZKNsPpj.
Good. Did the NVMe drive arrive? I'm still waiting on it.
I don't have real-time tracking access, so I can't confirm the delivery status. Have you tried refreshing your email for a new tracking update?
Yeah, I did. Still says 'preparing for shipment'. Annoying. I might just go buy one locally if it doesn't show up by tomorrow.
That might be a safer bet if you need to start building immediately. Local stores usually have 500GB drives in stock.
I'll check the mall tonight. Also, don't forget the new Discord link for when I ask you to generate the footer HTML later.
Understood. I'll use the updated link when we generate the HTML.
